question: Which AI agents create the most value?
html:
The context does not rank the 45 agents one by one. At the company and wave level, value concentrates in Thomas Scientific and Frontline agents and in the wave-three revenue agents, all est. (Portfolio AI-agent plan).

Value by portfolio company

The program totals about $12.7M a year of run-rate EBITDA-equivalent value once ramped (est.). That figure is not de-duplicated.

Portfolio companyEst. annual valueRoadmap range
Thomas Scientific$3.84M$1.25–4.8M
Frontline Managed Services$3.59M$1.5–4.2M
Bully Pulpit International$2.27M$0.85–3.75M
Commonwealth Electrical Technologies$1.32M$0.62–2.62M
Punctual Pros$0.88M$0.32–1.12M
Fair Harbor$0.77M$0.40–1.75M

(Portfolio AI-agent plan, Oct 6, 2026)

  • Thomas Scientific and Frontline together make up about 59% of the total (est.).
  • Each company's total sits inside its ServiceOS evidence roadmap range.

Value by rollout wave

  • Wave 3, revenue agents: $4.19M (est.), the largest wave.
  • Wave 2, finance agents: $3.91M (est.).
  • Wave 1, inbound-contact and document agents: $2.81M (est.). These have the clearest baselines and the lowest risk.
  • Wave 4, monitoring services: $1.77M (est.).

(Portfolio AI-agent plan)

Strongest single-agent case

The Punctual Pros missed-call and after-hours booking agent is the only agent with a worked model in the context:

  • It recovers about $1.37M a year of revenue (est.) from unanswered calls.
  • Outbound membership renewal adds about $403k a year (est.).
  • Together that is about 8.1% of Punctual Pros revenue (Voice AI research).

These are revenue figures, not EBITDA. They should not be compared directly with the $0.88M EBITDA-equivalent total for Punctual Pros.

Limits of the data

  • Agent-level value figures exist in the plan, but only 2 of 61 items are shown here. A true agent ranking needs each agent's estimated annual value field.
  • All volumes are analyst assumptions. These include calls, tickets, invoices, quotes and members.
  • Many metric claims rest on vendor case studies that are self-reported and unaudited (Voice AI research).
  • The Punctual Pros call volume of about 3,502 a month is backed out of an estimated $22M of revenue. It is not a system count.
  • The missed-call model is sensitive to the missed share. The modelled range runs from 10% to 35%.

Next actions

  1. Pull the full agent list with estimated annual value. Rank the top ten agents across the portfolio, and remove any value counted twice.
  2. Replace the assumed volumes with system-of-record counts at Thomas Scientific and Frontline first, since they carry the most value.
  3. Pull Punctual Pros phone-system data on missed and abandoned calls and booking rates. Use it to confirm the missed-call case before the wave-one launch.
  4. Convert the voice-agent revenue estimates to EBITDA using actual job margins, so agents can be compared on one basis.
